items.name: Kopi Susu Senja Gula Aren
items.description: Espresso blend arabika gayo, susu segar creamy, dan gula aren organik cair khas Nusantara.
items.descriptionEn: Gayo Arabica espresso blend, creamy fresh milk, and authentic Indonesian organic liquid palm sugar.

items.name: Caffe Latte Double Shot
items.description: Double ristretto dengan microfoam susu steamed lembut dan silky latte art.
items.descriptionEn: Double ristretto with silky steamed fresh milk microfoam and delicate latte art.

items.name: Caramel Macchiato Ice
items.description: Espresso bold dengan vanilla syrup, susu segar, dan siraman saus karamel gurih di atasnya.
items.descriptionEn: Bold espresso layered with vanilla syrup, chilled fresh milk, and rich caramel drizzle.

items.name: Kyoto Matcha Latte
items.description: Pure ceremonial matcha Jepang grade A berpadu dengan fresh milk gurih dan aroma floral harum.
items.descriptionEn: Ceremonial grade A Japanese matcha harmoniously blended with fresh milk and delicate floral aroma.

items.name: Earl Grey Milk Tea
items.description: Teh hitam Earl Grey beraroma minyak bergamot Italia disajikan dengan susu kental lembut.
items.descriptionEn: Fragrant Italian bergamot Earl Grey black tea infused with velvety smooth milk.

items.name: French Butter Croissant
items.description: Pastry Prancis berlayer renyah keemasan dengan mentega butter asli impor yang harum dan empuk di dalam.
items.descriptionEn: Crispy golden layered French pastry baked with imported European butter, airy and soft inside.

items.name: Almond Pain au Chocolat
items.description: Pastry cokelat Belgia bertabur irisan kacang almond renyah panggang dan krim almond lembut.
items.descriptionEn: Belgian chocolate puff pastry filled with rich almond frangipane cream and toasted sliced almonds.

items.name: San Sebastian Basque Cheesecake
items.description: Kue keju panggang Spanyol dengan lapisan karamel terbakar eksotis dan bagian tengah keju lumer meleleh.
items.descriptionEn: Authentic Spanish baked cheesecake with a caramelized burnt crust and molten creamy cheese center.
